This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which 
must be performed every six months or 8000 operating hours as indicated by Y1 or 
H8000 in the title block

This document initiated by eng. El-Saeid Mohamed 
 Matarid, tested by eng. Ashraf Kamal El-Din Otba, reviewed by eng. Reda Ragab 
 Karam, approved by eng. Hamdy Ahmed Dorgham general director, accepted by eng. 
 Maamoun Abou El-Magd Atta Allah head sector of Damanhour Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona El-Sharkawy: 
 WEDC inspection & quality control head sector, MPIS coordinator.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, 
safety glasses is required.
The motor must be out of service.
